brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the influence of HRS9531 injection on pharmacokinetics of metformin in healthy subjects.
brief_title: Influence of HRS9531 on Pharmacokinetics of Metformin in Healthy Subjects
official_title: A Single Center, Open-label, Single Cohort, Fixed Sequence Trial, Investigating the Influence of HRS9531 Injection on Pharmacokinetics of Metformin in Healthy Subjects

primary_outcomes.measure: Area under the concentration versus time curve (AUC) of metformin from dosing time (0) to tau (dosing interval) (AUCtau) after 3.5 days.
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Start of treatment up to 12 hours.

sites.facility: The Second Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University
